title: Michael A NDE 4521
content: A few days post-operative I was laying in the intensive care unit and I felt a fluttering, alarms on the monitor sounded and hospital staff came running in and place a board under me. My gown was pulled off and 'equipment attached to wires from my chest'. I was already looking down on myself. I pulled out of my body at the time the board was placed under me. All of a sudden, I was back in my body looking down at my feet. I did not experience any pain.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Hospital staff resuscitated and I returned to my body after floating against ceiling. I do not recall a jolt on returning. 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' 'Two days following 4 vessel cabg. cardiac arrest Laying hospital bed and floated above body and saw staff running around. I was looking down on myself.' Cardiac arrest. Wires out of chest and hospital staff running around and I watched from out of body and floating above.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Appeared to be at same level of conscious all the way through the arrest and resuscitation.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Felt like there was a mirror on the ceiling. That is as close to a description as I can get.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I was not as blind in those days as I am now.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: A lot of noise with staff talking back and forth and from the cardiac equipment.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No Only medical staff. One was a doctor.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Uncertain I am not sure. Relationships with whom?
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain I am not sure. Relationships with whom? After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Two years. My wife is a registered nurse and understands since she had this experience with patients. She encouraged me to vent my experience and feelings.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Mystified. Unaware this could happen. Never hear of anything like this before.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real In June and July of 2009 my cardiac defibrillator malfunctioned. Thirteen shocks and I was expecting another experience similar to the one in 1993.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes As above, in June and July of 2009 when my defibrillator malfunctioned I was sure and was expecting the same occurrence.
